rules.rule: Vega-positive strategies (long options) profit from volatility expansion. When VIX is historically low (< 15), buying options (long Vega) is cheap. When VIX spikes above 30, selling options (short Vega) captures elevated premium. Map current VIX level to strategy preference: VIX < 15: buy vol. VIX 15-25: neutral. VIX > 25: sell vol.

parameter_impact.description: VIX-based volatility regime: low VIX favors long-vol, high VIX favors short-vol
